data.name: Deathtouch
data.detailed_description:
DEATHTOUCH

An Open World Horror Experience

Enter a vast, eerie world filled with secrets, dangers, and the unknown. DEATHTOUCH is an open-world horror game designed for true explorers—those who dare to venture into the shadows and uncover hidden truths.

🔎 Explore Beyond the Surface – Every corner of this world holds mysteries waiting to be discovered. Follow winding paths, descend into forgotten caves, and unlock hidden areas teeming with secrets and Easter eggs. The deeper you go, the more you’ll realize… you were never alone.

😱 Survive the Unknown – The world of DEATHTOUCH is alive with terror. Ominous whispers, sudden jump scares, and unspeakable horrors lurk in the darkness, ready to strike when you least expect it. Not everything can be fought—sometimes, your only choice is to RUN.

🌎 A Living, Breathing Nightmare – DEATHTOUCH ensures that something is always happening. Strange occurrences, unexpected events, and an atmosphere thick with tension make every moment unpredictable.

⚠️ Do You Have the Courage to Keep Exploring?

There is no safety. There is no escape. There is only the thrill of the unknown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (with DirectX 12 support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better (with DirectX 12 support)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12-compatible sound card

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description

This game contains frequent depictions of violence, including shooting enemies and zombies with visible blood effects upon impact. Players may encounter tense and frightening moments due to the game's dark and atmospheric environments, which may not be suitable for all audiences.

Content Includes:

- Use of firearms and shooting mechanics

- Blood effects when enemies or the player are hit

- Scary or intense scenes that may startle some players

There are no depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug use, or self-harm in this game.
